description: Polyfill implementation for MutationObserver and WeakMap, providing support for these features in environments lacking native support.

classes.name: JsMutationObserver
classes.description: A polyfill class for MutationObserver, providing DOM mutation observation capabilities.

classes.name: Registration
classes.description: Internal class managing individual mutation observer registrations and event handling.

classes.name: MutationRecord
classes.description: Represents information about a DOM mutation event.

methods.name: observe
methods.description: Starts observing a target node for specified mutations.

methods.name: takeRecords
methods.description: Returns a list of mutation records and clears the internal record list.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the WeakMap.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the WeakMap by key.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a key-value pair from the WeakMap.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the WeakMap.
